units.title: Angles and the Unit Circle
units.blurb: Measure angles in radians and define sine and cosine for every angle.

units.title: Graphs of Trig Functions
units.blurb: Graph sinusoids, model periodic change, and define the inverse trig functions.

units.title: Identities and Equations
units.blurb: Prove identities, use sum and multiple-angle formulas, and solve trig equations.

units.title: Oblique Triangles and Vectors
units.blurb: Handle the ambiguous case, then use vectors for forces and motion.

units.title: Polar Coordinates and Complex Numbers
units.blurb: Describe points and curves with polar coordinates, and multiply complex numbers as rotations.

units.title: Parametric Equations
units.blurb: Describe motion with a parameter and eliminate it to find the path.

units.title: Conic Sections
units.blurb: Write and graph parabolas, ellipses and hyperbolas, and identify a conic from its equation.

units.title: Matrices
units.blurb: Add, multiply and invert matrices, and use them to solve systems and transform the plane.

units.title: Toward Calculus
units.blurb: Decompose fractions, prove by induction, and meet difference quotients and limits.

topics.title: Angles in Standard Position
topics.short: Draw angles from the positive x-axis, including negative and coterminal angles.
topics.trouble: Students measure clockwise as positive, or think 400° is not a real angle.

topics.title: Radian Measure
topics.short: One radian is the angle whose arc equals the radius.
topics.trouble: Students think a radian measure must contain π, so they do not see 2 as an angle.

topics.title: Converting Degrees and Radians
topics.short: Multiply by π/180 or 180/π.
topics.trouble: Students multiply by the wrong factor and get answers like 30° = 5400/π.

topics.title: Arc Length, Sector Area and Angular Speed
topics.short: s = rθ and A = ½r²θ when θ is in radians.
topics.trouble: Students use degrees in s = rθ.

topics.title: Sine and Cosine on the Unit Circle
topics.short: (cos θ, sin θ) is the point at angle θ on the unit circle.
topics.trouble: Students swap the coordinates, taking sine as the x-coordinate.

topics.title: Exact Values at Special Angles
topics.short: Use 30-60-90 and 45-45-90 triangles to find exact values.
topics.trouble: Students swap sin 30° and sin 60°, writing sin 30° = √3/2.

topics.title: Reference Angles and Signs by Quadrant
topics.short: Find values in any quadrant from a reference angle and a sign.
topics.trouble: Students use the right value with the wrong sign, such as cos 120° = +1/2.

topics.title: Symmetry and Periodicity
topics.short: sin(−θ) = −sin θ, cos(−θ) = cos θ, and both repeat every 2π.

topics.title: All Six Trig Functions
topics.short: Tangent, cotangent, secant and cosecant from sine and cosine.
topics.trouble: Students pair secant with sine because both start with s.

topics.title: The Pythagorean Identity
topics.short: sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, and finding one value from another.
topics.trouble: Students find the size of cos θ but forget to choose its sign from the quadrant.

topics.title: Graphs of Sine and Cosine
topics.short: Unroll the unit circle into a wave.

topics.title: Amplitude and Period
topics.short: In y = A sin(Bx), the amplitude is |A| and the period is 2π/B.
topics.trouble: Students take B as the period instead of 2π/B.

topics.title: Phase Shift and Midline
topics.short: y = A sin(B(x − h)) + k shifts by h and centers on y = k.
topics.trouble: Students read the shift of sin(2x − π) as π instead of π/2.

topics.title: Modeling with Sinusoids
topics.short: Fit a sine curve to tides, daylight and Ferris wheels.

topics.title: Graphs of Tangent, Secant and Cosecant
topics.short: Find asymptotes where cosine or sine is zero.
topics.trouble: Students give tangent the same period as sine, 2π instead of π.

topics.title: Damped Oscillation
topics.short: Multiply a sinusoid by a decaying exponential.

topics.title: Inverse Trig Functions
topics.short: Restrict sine, cosine and tangent so they have inverses.
topics.trouble: Students read sin⁻¹ x as 1/sin x, or give an angle outside the restricted range.

topics.title: Compositions with Inverse Trig
topics.short: Evaluate expressions like sin⁻¹(sin 5π/6) and cos(tan⁻¹ x).
topics.trouble: Students cancel sin⁻¹(sin θ) to θ even when θ is outside [−π/2, π/2].

topics.title: Reciprocal, Quotient and Pythagorean Identities
topics.short: Rewrite trig expressions in terms of sine and cosine.

topics.title: Verifying Identities
topics.short: Transform one side until it matches the other.
topics.trouble: Students treat an identity as an equation and do the same thing to both sides, assuming what they want to prove.

topics.title: Sum and Difference Formulas
topics.short: sin(a + b) = sin a cos b + cos a sin b.
topics.trouble: Students write sin(a + b) = sin a + sin b.

topics.title: Double-Angle Formulas
topics.short: sin 2θ = 2 sin θ cos θ and three forms of cos 2θ.
topics.trouble: Students write sin 2θ = 2 sin θ.

topics.title: Half-Angle and Power-Reducing Formulas
topics.short: Rewrite sin²θ and cos²θ in terms of cos 2θ.
topics.trouble: Students choose the sign of a half-angle value from θ instead of from θ/2.

topics.title: Solving Basic Trig Equations
topics.short: Find every solution in one period, then all solutions.
topics.trouble: Students stop at the calculator's one answer and miss the second solution in [0, 2π).

topics.title: Trig Equations with Factoring and Multiple Angles
topics.short: Factor, use identities, and handle 2θ and 3θ.
topics.trouble: Students divide both sides by sin x and lose the solutions where sin x = 0.

topics.title: The Ambiguous Case
topics.short: With two sides and a non-included angle there may be 0, 1 or 2 triangles.
topics.trouble: Students find one triangle from sin⁻¹ and miss the second one with the supplementary angle.

topics.title: Bearings and Triangle Applications
topics.short: Solve navigation and surveying problems with the laws of sines and cosines.
topics.trouble: Students measure a bearing from the x-axis instead of from north.

topics.title: Heron's Formula
topics.short: Find a triangle's area from its three sides.
topics.trouble: Students use the full perimeter where the formula needs half of it.

topics.title: Vectors
topics.short: A vector has a size and a direction.
topics.trouble: Students treat a vector's components as a point rather than as a displacement.

topics.title: Vector Components and Magnitude
topics.short: v = ⟨|v| cos θ, |v| sin θ⟩.
topics.trouble: Students find the direction angle with tan⁻¹ but ignore the quadrant.

topics.title: Adding and Scaling Vectors
topics.short: Add tip to tail; scaling stretches or flips.

topics.title: Velocity and Force Problems
topics.short: Find a resultant for wind, current and forces.
topics.trouble: Students add the speeds instead of the velocity vectors.

topics.title: The Dot Product and the Angle Between Vectors
topics.short: u · v = |u||v| cos θ.
topics.trouble: Students treat the dot product as a vector rather than a number.

topics.title: Vector Projections and Work
topics.short: Split a vector into parts along and across another vector.

topics.title: Polar Coordinates
topics.short: Locate points by distance r and angle θ.
topics.trouble: Students forget that one point has many polar names, including ones with negative r.

topics.title: Converting Polar and Rectangular
topics.short: x = r cos θ, y = r sin θ, and back again.
topics.trouble: Students take θ = tan⁻¹(y/x) for a point in the second or third quadrant without adjusting.

topics.title: Graphs of Polar Equations
topics.short: Sketch circles, cardioids, roses and limaçons.
topics.trouble: Students plot r as a y-value against θ on ordinary axes.

topics.title: Complex Numbers in the Plane
topics.short: Plot a + bi and find its modulus.

topics.title: Polar Form of a Complex Number
topics.short: z = r(cos θ + i sin θ).

topics.title: Multiplying, Powers and De Moivre's Theorem
topics.short: Multiply moduli and add angles; zⁿ = rⁿ(cos nθ + i sin nθ).
topics.trouble: Students multiply the angles instead of adding them.

topics.title: nth Roots of Complex Numbers
topics.short: A nonzero number has n nth roots spread evenly around a circle.
topics.trouble: Students find only one root, forgetting to add multiples of 2π/n.

topics.title: Parametric Equations
topics.short: x and y both depend on a third variable t.
topics.trouble: Students lose the direction of motion, which the equation in x and y alone does not show.

topics.title: Eliminating the Parameter
topics.short: Solve for t or use an identity to get one equation in x and y.

topics.title: Projectile Motion with Parametric Equations
topics.short: Model a launched object with x = v₀t cos θ and y = h + v₀t sin θ − 16t².
topics.trouble: Students use the whole launch speed for both the horizontal and the vertical motion.

topics.title: Parabolas as Conics
topics.short: Use focus, directrix and vertex for parabolas opening any way.
topics.trouble: Students forget that p is the distance from the vertex to the focus, not from the focus to the directrix.

topics.title: Ellipses
topics.short: The sum of distances to two foci is constant; c² = a² − b².
topics.trouble: Students use c² = a² + b² for an ellipse, or mix up which axis is major.

topics.title: Hyperbolas
topics.short: The difference of distances to two foci is constant; c² = a² + b².
topics.trouble: Students draw the hyperbola opening the wrong way, or use the ellipse relation for c.

topics.title: Identifying Conics from Equations
topics.short: Complete the square to name and graph any conic.

topics.title: Matrices and Matrix Arithmetic
topics.short: Add matrices and multiply them by numbers.

topics.title: Multiplying Matrices
topics.short: Each entry is a row times a column.
topics.trouble: Students multiply matching entries, or assume AB = BA.

topics.title: Solving Systems with Row Operations
topics.short: Write an augmented matrix and row-reduce it.
topics.trouble: Students add a multiple of a row to itself or forget to apply an operation to the constants column.

topics.title: Determinants of 2 × 2 and 3 × 3 Matrices
topics.short: ad − bc, and expansion by minors.
topics.trouble: Students compute ad + bc, or lose the alternating signs in a 3 × 3 expansion.

topics.title: Inverse Matrices
topics.short: A⁻¹ exists exactly when det A ≠ 0.
topics.trouble: Students invert each entry separately.

topics.title: Solving Systems with Inverse Matrices
topics.short: Write AX = B and multiply by A⁻¹ on the left.
topics.trouble: Students multiply by A⁻¹ on the right, computing BA⁻¹.

topics.title: Matrices as Transformations
topics.short: A 2 × 2 matrix moves the plane, and |det| scales area.

topics.title: Partial Fraction Decomposition
topics.short: Split a rational expression into simpler fractions.
topics.trouble: Students use a constant numerator over a quadratic factor that needs Ax + B.

topics.title: Proof by Induction
topics.short: Prove a base case, then show each case implies the next.
topics.trouble: Students prove the next case by assuming it is true, or skip the base case.

topics.title: Logistic Growth
topics.short: Growth that slows near a carrying capacity.

topics.title: The Difference Quotient
topics.short: [f(x + h) − f(x)]/h is the slope of a secant line.
topics.trouble: Students write f(x + h) as f(x) + h, or f(x) + f(h).

topics.title: The Idea of a Limit
topics.short: A limit is the value a function approaches, not necessarily its value.
topics.trouble: Students think a limit is just f(a), and that it cannot exist where f(a) is undefined.

topics.title: Estimating Limits from Graphs and Tables
topics.short: Read limits from the left and the right.
